messages.content: [User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I turn on push notifications for order updates?

Welcome to Auxin Help Center! Go to Profile > Notification Settings in the app and toggle 'Push Notifications' to ON. You will receive real-time alerts when your order is accepted by the farmer, picked up by the courier, and out for delivery.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How does Auxin's direct farm-to-doorstep model work?

Auxin eliminates middleman wholesale markets. Local farmers post fresh morning harvests directly on our platform. When you place an order, a local courier picks up the produce straight from the farm and delivers it directly to your home within hours, guaranteeing maximum freshness and fair prices for farmers.
[User Role: FARMER]
I am a local farmer. How can I join Auxin to sell my vegetables?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. We'd love to have you onboard! Simply download the Auxin app, select 'Sign Up', choose 'Farmer' as your role, enter your phone number, and complete your farm profile (farm location and bank details).
How long does verification take?
Our admin team verifies farm details and bank accounts within 12 to 24 hours. Once approved, you can immediately start listing your fresh harvests under our Master Catalogue!
[User Role: DELIVERY]
I am not getting sound alerts when new delivery orders are assigned to me.

Make sure your device notification permissions for Auxin are set to 'Allowed' with sound turned ON. Also, check that your phone is not in 'Do Not Disturb' mode and that your availability toggle in the Delivery Portal is set to 'Available'.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I create a support ticket for an unfulfilled order?

Go to Help Center > Contact Support in your app. Tap 'Create Ticket', select your order ID, choose issue category 'Order Unfulfilled', describe the problem, and submit. Our customer support team will respond within 2 hours.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Is my payment safe when I order on Auxin?

Yes, 100%! All online payments are processed via Razorpay and held securely in escrow. Your payment is NOT released to the farmer until you receive your produce and verify the delivery with your 6-digit OTP.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I update my email address for electronic receipts?
Open your profile tab, tap 'Edit Profile', enter your preferred email address, and click 'Save Changes'. Digital receipts for all future orders will be sent to this email address.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What should I do if I forget my password?
On the login screen, tap 'Forgot Password?'. Enter your registered mobile phone number (+91 format). A 6-digit verification code will be sent via SMS. Enter the code and set your new password.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What does certified organic mean on Auxin?

Items tagged with the green 'Organic' badge are grown by verified farmers using natural vermicompost and zero chemical pesticides or GMOs. Farmers log detailed cultivation notes for every organic harvest batch.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What notifications will I receive after placing an order?

You will receive real-time notifications for every milestone: 1. 'Order Placed' (payment held in escrow), 2. 'Order Accepted' (farmer packaging harvest), 3. 'Out for Delivery' (courier en route with live map tracking), and 4. 'Delivered' (upon handoff OTP verification).
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
My refund has not arrived after 5 days. How can I escalate this?
Go to Help Center > My Tickets, select your refund ticket, and tap 'Escalate to Supervisor'. Our finance team will review the Razorpay transaction reference ID and provide an immediate update.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
How do I become a delivery partner on Auxin?

Download the Auxin app, select 'Sign Up', choose 'Delivery Partner' as your role, enter your phone number, driving license, vehicle registration, and bank details. Once verified by our admin team (within 12 hours), you can toggle your status to 'Available' and start earning!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How can I request account deletion?

Navigate to Profile > Privacy & Security, scroll down, and tap 'Delete Account'. After verifying via SMS OTP, your account, saved addresses, and profile data will be permanently removed from our active database.
[User Role: FARMER]
What alert do I get when a customer orders produce from my inventory?

You will receive an instant high-priority alert on your Farmer Portal displaying the order ID, items, quantities, and customer area. You can tap 'Accept Order' to start packaging the produce for pickup.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I am new to Auxin. How do I start shopping?

Welcome! Shopping is simple: 1. Browse produce on the home screen or search by category. 2. Add items from your chosen farm to your cart. 3. Proceed to checkout, enter your delivery address, and complete payment. 4. Use your 6-digit OTP to collect your farm-fresh delivery!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why is my SMS OTP taking long to arrive?

SMS delivery can occasionally be delayed by mobile network congestion. Please wait 60 seconds for the resend timer, make sure mobile signal is active, and tap 'Resend OTP'. You can also request an automated voice call OTP if available.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I send a system notice to farmers about upcoming system maintenance?

Go to Admin Dashboard > Broadcast Center, select recipient role 'Farmer', compose the notification text ('System Maintenance Notice'), set scheduled time, and click 'Broadcast'. All active farmers will receive an in-app notice.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I pay using UPI apps like Google Pay or PhonePe?
Yes! Razorpay checkout on Auxin supports all major UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), Credit/Debit cards, Netbanking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
[User Role: DELIVERY]
Why does the app require location access set to 'Always Allow'?
Location access set to 'Always Allow' enables real-time courier routing, accurate ETA calculations for customers, and geofence validation when completing handoff OTPs.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I set my home address as default?
Go to Profile > Saved Addresses. Tap the three dots next to your Home address and select 'Set as Default'. This address will automatically be selected for all future checkouts.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why do Auxin products show harvest dates?
Showing harvest dates empowers transparency! You know exactly when your produce was picked. Auxin automatically hides listings older than 30 days so you never receive stale warehouse stock.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What are Auxin customer support operating hours?
Our AI assistant Milo is available 24/7! Human customer support agents operate daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM to resolve order, payment, and delivery tickets.
[User Role: FARMER]
How do I update my registered bank account for payouts?
Go to Farmer Portal > Bank Settings, enter your new account number and IFSC code, and tap 'Save'. Bank details are encrypted immediately using Fernet symmetric encryption for security.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What should I do if I change my phone number?
Go to Profile > Account Settings > Change Mobile Number. Enter your new phone number. Verify the OTP sent to your new number, and your account credentials will update automatically.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How does buying on Auxin support local Indian farmers?

Auxin gives local farmers direct digital access to consumers, allowing them to set fair prices for their harvest without middleman cuts. Payments are released directly to their bank accounts, boosting rural livelihoods!
[User Role: FARMER]
